research_scope: Current public Foodpanda outlet-menu pages only. Three named mall outlets were exact-joined to Refresh128 directory rows by street, unit, mall and postal code; each licence was checked to have zero Menu Items rows and a blank Menu / Price summary. Fifteen item/price proposals are factual listings; promotional and from-prices are preserved as displayed. No images, descriptions, ratings, closure claims, paid calls, login, or orders.

limitations: Foodpanda delivery listing prices and availability can differ from dine-in and are volatile; “from” and promo prices must be retained exactly as presented and rechecked before use.

Foodpanda terms and platform accuracy caveats were previously reviewed in platform_menu_rights_review_20261019.json; proposals contain only factual item labels and prices and do not claim a general republication license.
Foodpanda-hosted images, descriptions, ratings, and reviews were not copied or proposed.
An outlet appearing in a public mall directory supports public-access venue identification; delivery listing alone is not treated as proof of permanent operation or permanent closure.
